newsitem.title: USA: Excel's Ottumwa pork plant seen closed next week.
newsitem.headline: Excel's Ottumwa pork plant seen closed next week.

text.p: Excel Corp officials on Thursday were inspecting the company's fire-damaged Ottumwa, Iowa, pork plant, which has been closed indefinitely, said an Excel spokesman
"We probably will not be open next week," said spokesman Mark Klein.
Klein said company officials are working on a timetable to reopen the 20-year-old plant but no reopening date has be set.
An apparent ammonia leak caused an explosion and fire late Sunday that severely damaged the roof and walls at the plant's shipping facilities, company and fire officials said.
The fire has been extinguished but a fire crew remained at the plant while company employees emptied ammonia tanks.
No official damage estimate has been released, but Ottumwa Fire Chief Dan Thompson said damages will be "at least a couple of million (dollars)."
The plant's pork production has been shifted to Excel plants in Beardstown, Ill., and Marshall, Mo., and customers orders were being filled, said Klein.
Excel is a division of Cargill Inc.
On Wednesday hourly workers had begun filing for unemployment benefits.
